ACCOUNT & DATA DELETION

Your profile.
Your choice.

Flap Fit does not require an email, phone number, or password. An anonymous online profile is created only if you accept the Competition Terms and use Compete.

Delete in the app

  1. Open Flap Fit.
  2. Open the Info tab.
  3. Select Delete online profile.
  4. Confirm Delete.

What is deleted: the anonymous authentication user and associated player name, leaderboard scores, challenges, challenge attempts, and blocks. Local bird, level, score, and training history stored only on the phone are not deleted by this action.

WITHOUT THE APP

Request deletion by email

Email support@flapfitapp.com with the subject Flap Fit account deletion. Include your player name and any challenge code, exercise leaderboard, approximate score, and approximate date that can help us locate the anonymous profile.

Do not send camera images, workout videos, passwords, government identification, or other sensitive information. We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 days and complete a verified request within 30 days, unless applicable law requires a shorter period or permits an extension.

Email deletion request ↗

What may be retained temporarily

Pending moderation reports remain until review. Resolved reports are removed after 180 days, but an account identifier is removed sooner when its associated account is deleted. Security logs and backups may remain for the limited periods configured by the production provider before automatic deletion or rotation.

Because the profile is anonymous, we may need additional non-sensitive competition details to avoid deleting another player's data. If we cannot safely identify the profile, we will explain the next available step.

Privacy questions

Read the Privacy Policy or contact Troy Reardon at support@flapfitapp.com.
